d: Badla, Game Over, Manmarziyaan, Mission Mangal, Saand Ki Aankh, Neevevaro, Mulk, Soorma, Naam Shabana, The Ghazi Attack ... the list of Taapsee Pannu's incredible movies is endless. Taapsee is one of the most talented actresses in Bollywood, She never shied away from taking up challenging and unconventional roles, uniques subjects and social issues. Here in The Slow Interview, Taapsee talks about her journey so far. This is a beautiful interview where she opens up about Bollywood, Tollywood, family, friends and her thoughts on social issues.
